corrections: 【0.4% 的口径】修正前:笼统说“最多解释 0.4% 的方差”。修正后:0.4% 是三数据集各自“完整 SCA 规格曲线的中位数 partial η²”中的最大值(MCS = 0.004;YRBS = 0.001;MTF < 0.001),不是所有规格里的上限。同一篇 Table 2 中多个子分析明显超过 0.4%:MCS「仅是否拥有电脑」partial η² = 0.011(1.1%)、「仅社交媒体使用时长」= 0.009(0.9%)、「仅家庭上网」= 0.006、「仅青少年自评幸福感」= 0.008。写作时应说“中位规格下最多 0.4%”,不能写成“任何算法下都不超过 0.4%”。

【摘要引语的限定语】修正前:引作“…too small to warrant policy change”。修正后:原句为 “Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.” —— 结论带前置限定“把数据的更广背景纳入考虑后”。用省略号跳接会把一个有条件的推论变成无条件断言,建议整句引。

【n=355,358 的分母】修正前:直接用 n=355,358 作为分析样本量。修正后:这是三个互相独立数据集的加总(YRBS 74,814 = 37,402 女 + 37,412 男;MTF 268,672 = 136,190 + 132,482;MCS 11,872 = 5,926 + 5,946),论文自己在 Methods 明写“实际分析的样本量往往更小,有些情况小一个数量级以上”。实际规格中位 n:YRBS ≈ 62,297、MTF ≈ 78,267、MCS ≈ 7,968。承载“土豆/眼镜”对比的 MCS 分析,中位 n 只有约 7,9xx,不是 35 万。
【2007–2016 的时间窗】修正前:说“三数据集覆盖 2007-2016”。修正后:2007–2016 是三者合并的外包络,不是共同窗口。原文 Methods:YRBS 样本取自 2007–2015;MTF 取自 2008–2016;MCS 是出生于 2000 年 9 月–2001 年 1 月的固定队列、分析用的是 13–15 岁那一轮(单次横截面)。

【土豆 0.9x / 眼镜 1.5x 是正文四舍五入值】修正前:0.9x、1.5x。修正后:论文 Table 3 的精确值是 潜在对比倍数 ×0.86(土豆,YRBS)与 ×1.45(眼镜,MCS);0.9 与 1.5 是论文 Discussion 正文自己的约整写法。两种写法都出自一手,但引精确值更稳。另注意方向:×0.86 意味着吃土豆的负相关略小于科技使用(科技使用反而大约 16% 更负),原文措辞是“nearly as negative as”,不是“更糟”。

【睡眠/早餐 1.7x–44.2x 需带方向与不稳定性标注】修正前:并列成“睡眠早餐 1.7x-44.2x”。修正后:原文是 “ranging from ×1.7 to ×44.2 more positive in all datasets” —— 这是**反向**(保护性)效应的量级比,Table 3 中这几格都带 * 号,注释明写“therefore in the opposite direction to the effect of technology use”。精确表值:睡眠 YRBS ×3.06 / MTF ×44.23 / MCS ×1.65;早餐 YRBS ×2.37 / MTF ×30.55 / MCS ×3.32(区间下界 1.7 来自 MCS 睡眠 1.65 的约整)。另需注意 MTF 的 44.23× 与 30.55× 是被近零分母撑大的:MTF 科技使用平均 β 仅 −0.006,比值在此极不稳定,不宜单独当修辞锚点。
【大麻 2.7x / 霸凌 4.3x 只是 YRBS 值,跨数据集差异极大】修正前:未标注数据集依赖性。修正后:Table 3 显示大麻 YRBS ×2.70 / MTF ×10.09 / MCS ×1.14;霸凌 YRBS ×4.33 / MTF 无 / MCS ×4.92。大麻在 MCS 里只比科技使用大 1.14 倍,几乎打平——用 2.7x 代表“大麻普遍比屏幕严重得多”会夸大稳健性。
【利益披露需交代】修正前:未提。修正后:论文 Competing interests 自述:A.O. 无;A.K.P. 无财务利益冲突,但过去五年以**无薪顾问**身份服务于 OECD、Facebook Inc.、Google Inc. 与 ParentZone。这不构成推翻论断的理由(且是论文自己披露的),但若文章把该研究当作对抗“屏幕有害论”的核心证据,应主动交代。
evidence_notes: 一手全文两版独立核对且逐字一致:出版版 PDF 镜像 https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/2019-orben.pdf ;作者接受稿(AAM)https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5d844350-a359-47d3-b10c-4bfb93ce613b/download_file?file_format=application%2Fpdf&safe_filename=Orben-and-Przybylski-Nature-Human-Behaviour-AAM.pdf&type_of_work=Journal+article (nature.com 正文被 idp.nature.com 登录墙 303 挡住,故走镜像)。

摘要逐字(出版版):“…by applying specification curve analysis (SCA) across three large-scale social datasets (total n = 355,358) to rigorously examine correlational evidence for the effects of digital technology on adolescents. The association we find between digital technology use and adolescent well-being is negative but small, explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being. Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.” —— 论断 (a) 的两段引语逐字成立。

Methods 逐字:“encompassing a total of 355,358, predominately 12- to 18-year-old adolescents surveyed between the years 2007 and 2016.” 以及 “While the omnibus sample of adolescents totals 355,358 teenagers, it is important to note that the sample sizes of the analyses are often smaller, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more.”

Methods 逐字分数据集:YRBS “collected from 2007 to 2015 and included 37,402 girls and 37,412 boys”;MTF “collected from 2008 to 2016, and included 136,190 girls and 132,482 boys”;MCS “comprised 5,926 girls and 5,946 boys who ranged in age from 13 to 15 years (mean 13.77, s.d. 0.45)”。三者相加 = 355,358,算术自洽。

Discussion 逐字:“in all three datasets the effects of both smoking marijuana and bullying have much larger negative associations with adolescent well-being (×2.7 and ×4.3, respectively for the YRBS) than does technology use.”
Discussion 逐字:“…much more positive associations with well-being than the average impact of technology use (ranging from ×1.7 to ×44.2 more positive in all datasets).”

Discussion 逐字:“the association of well-being with regularly eating potatoes was nearly as negative as the association with technology use (×0.9, YRBS), and wearing glasses was more negatively associated with well-being (×1.5, MCS).” —— 论断 (c) 关于“非同一数据集”的提示正确:Table 3 中土豆一栏只有 YRBS 有值(MTF/MCS 为 –),眼镜一栏只有 MCS 有值(YRBS/MTF 为 –)。

Table 3(Comparison specifications)精确值,出版版与 AAM 两版一致:Marijuana ×2.70 / ×10.09 / ×1.14;Bullying ×4.33 / – / ×4.92;Potatoes ×0.86 / – / –;Glasses – / – / ×1.45;Handedness – / – / ×0.10;Sleep ×3.06* / ×44.23* / ×1.65*;Breakfast ×2.37* / ×30.55* / ×3.32*。表注:“The values indicate how many times larger the effects of the comparison variables are in comparison to technology use”,星号 = “therefore in the opposite direction to the effect of technology use”。表注给出分母:YRBS 平均 β = −0.049;MTF = −0.006;MCS = −0.042。

Table 2 反证 0.4% 的“上限”读法:完整 SCA 的中位 partial η² 为 YRBS 0.001、MTF <0.001、MCS 0.004;但同表子分析 MCS「Own a computer only」= 0.011、「Hours of social media use only」= 0.009、「Adolescent-report well-being only」= 0.008、「Use of home Internet only」= 0.006,均超 0.4%。

后续学术争议(不改变论断本身,但属背景):Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell, “Underestimating digital media harm”, Nat Hum Behav 4:346–348 (2020) https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-0839-4 ,主张小效应量源于分析选择;Orben & Przybylski 的 Reply https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-0840-y 逐条回应并补充分析。另有 Bayesian SCA 再分析(JRSS-C 71(5):1330, https://academic.oup.com/jrsssc/article/71/5/1330/7073288 )指出“取中位数会掩盖异质效应”。论文自身亦在 Discussion 承认自评科技使用测量噪声大、可能使效应被衰减。
论文对 YRBS 的写法为 “Youth Risk and Behaviour Survey”,与 CDC 官方名称 “Youth Risk Behavior Survey(lance System)” 略有出入;若文章中要给全称,建议用 CDC 官方写法并注明论文原文写法。
unresolved: nature.com 上的正式出版页(含 Matters Arising 与 Reply 全文)被 idp.nature.com 登录重定向阻断,Twenge et al. 2020 与 Orben & Przybylski 2020 Reply 的正文未能逐字核到,仅核到标题/卷页/主旨(经 Nature 目录页与 Haidt 个人站两处交叉印证)。若文章要引用这场往复的具体措辞,需另行取得全文。
Supplementary Information(含 Supplementary Table 2 的 bootstrap 结果、Supplementary Fig. 2–4 的逐规格 n 分布)未取得,故“各规格 n 的完整分布”只核到正文报告的中位数,未核到极值。
MTF 睡眠 ×44.23 / 早餐 ×30.55 的分子(MTF 睡眠、早餐的 median β)因出版版 PDF 双栏抽取串行,未能与 MTF 列可靠对应;倍数本身以 Table 3 表值为准,分母 β = −0.006 已核实,但无法独立复算这两个倍数。

evidence_notes: (a) 摘要逐字核对通过,两个独立镜像一致。PubMed (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30944443/) 与 ORA 著录页 (https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5d844350-a359-47d3-b10c-4bfb93ce613b) 的正式发表版摘要完全相同:『The association we find between digital technology use and adolescent well-being is negative but small, explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being. Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.』待验论断的省略号引法(negative but small…too small to warrant policy change)与原文一致,无篡改。
(a) 提醒(非错误但易被下游误用):省略号跨越了句号,略去了原文的限定语『Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are』。原文是有条件的『suggests』,不是无条件断言。正文引用时建议补全第二句,否则语气会比原文更绝对。

(a) 0.4% 的出处已精确定位:它不是三库合并值,而是三个数据集中最大的那个——MCS。作者在 2020 年 Reply(https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:de333ddc-cc14-4d56-a7f4-bfd913e94cc8/files/sn009w402m)明写『our original SCA (median β = - 0.032, percent variance explained = 0.4%)』,对应 AAM 正文 MCS 的 median β = -.032、median partial η² = .004。YRBS 的 partial η² = .001(0.1%),MTF < .001。故『at most 0.4%』字面成立,但另两库效应量还要小一个量级。构念单位是 partial η²(作者在 Reply 中称其为 r²),即方差解释比例,不是相关系数本身。

(b) n=355,358 逐字核对通过(AAM 摘要 ntot = 355,358;正文 Methods『encompassing a total of 355,358, predominately 12 to 18-year-old, adolescents surveyed between the years of 2007 and 2016』)。三数据集为 Youth Risk and Behaviour Survey (YRBS,美)、Monitoring the Future (MTF,美)、Millennium Cohort Study (MCS,英)。

(b) 分母口径关键提醒:355,358 是合并总人数,不是任何一次分析的分析样本。作者自己在 Methods 写明『the sample sizes of the analyses are often smaller, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more』。实际 median n:YRBS ≈ 62,166、MTF ≈ 115,000+、MCS ≈ 7,964。承载 0.4% 这个数字的 MCS 分析 median n 仅约 7,968。把『n=355,358』和『0.4%』并排放会造成量级错觉。

(b) 时间窗口 2007-2016 是三库并集,不是每库各自覆盖。AAM Methods 逐库为:YRBS『collected from 2007 to 2015』(双年调查,37,402 女 / 37,412 男,中位年龄 16);MTF『collected from 2008 to 2016』(136,190 女 / 132,482 男,12 年级因关键题项无法关联被排除);MCS 为 2000 年 9 月至 2001 年 1 月出生队列,分析样本 5,926 女 / 5,946 男,年龄 13-15(m=13.77),另含 10,605 名主要照护者。

(c) 四组倍数全部逐字核对通过,且可由正文报告的 β 复算。AAM Discussion 原文:『in all three datasets the effects of both smoking marijuana and bullying have much larger negative associations with adolescent well-being (2.7x and 4.3x respectively for YRBS) than technology use does』;『simple actions like getting enough sleep and regularly eating breakfast have much more positive associations with well-being than the average impact of technology use (ranging from 1.7x to 44.2x more positive in all datasets)』;『the association of well-being with regularly eating potatoes was nearly as negative as the association with technology use (0.9x, YRBS) and wearing glasses was more negatively associated with well-being (1.5x, MCS)』。

(c) 复算验证:YRBS 技术使用 median β = -.049;霸凌 -.212(÷.049 = 4.33 ≈ 4.3x)、大麻 -.132(= 2.69 ≈ 2.7x)、土豆 -.042(= 0.86 ≈ 0.9x)。MCS 技术使用 median β = -.042;眼镜 -.061(= 1.45 ≈ 1.5x)。区间下限 1.7x = MCS 睡眠 .070/.042 = 1.67;上限 44.2x 对应 MTF 睡眠 .246 除以 MTF 技术使用(报告为 median β = -.006,未四舍五入约 -.00557)。待验论断关于『土豆出自 YRBS、眼镜出自 MCS,非同一数据集』的限定完全正确——这正是原文的措辞。
(c) 原文自身的一处过度概括(下游引用需避开):Discussion 称大麻与霸凌『in all three datasets … much larger』,但在 MCS 中大麻 median β = -.048 对技术使用 -.042,仅约 1.14 倍,谈不上 much larger。2.7x/4.3x 只对 YRBS 成立。待验论断已正确限定为 YRBS,故论断本身无误。

反证检索结果:该文无勘误、无更正、无关注声明、无撤稿。PubMed 仅列两条 Comment in:Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell『Underestimating digital media harm』(Nat Hum Behav 2020, PMID 32303719, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-0839-4)与作者 Reply(PMID 32303718)。Twenge 等指控六项分析选择压低了效应量。作者按批评者要求重跑 SCA 后:『median association and effect size (β = - 0.051 [-0.072, -0.031], percent variance explained = 0.3% [0.2, 0.6]) are not significantly different from those in our original SCA』,且『Wearing glasses was still more negatively associated with well-being in adolescents than digital technology use (βglasses = − 0.061 vs βtechnology = − 0.051)』。即批评方的重分析未推翻本组三项论断中的任何一项。

对抗性补充(针对解释而非事实):Twenge & Haidt 2022 (Acta Psychologica, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0001691822000270) 用同批数据但只看社交媒体、按性别分层、剔除被其视为中介的心理控制变量,得到 median β 约 -0.11、女生最高约 -0.24,主张此时效应超过酗酒与大麻。作者自己在 Reply 中也承认女生关联更强(females median β = -0.069 vs males -0.037)。这动摇的是『too small to warrant policy change』这一政策推论的稳健性,不动摇论断组 (a)(b)(c) 所述的『该文说了什么』。若正文用该文支撑『屏幕时间无害』,应同时呈现聚合层级(全技术 vs 社交媒体、混合性别 vs 女生)会显著改变效应量这一事实。

利益相关核查:AAM Competing Interest Statement 原文『AO has no competing interests. AKP has no competing financial interests; In the last five years AKP has served in an unpaid advisory capacity to the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, Facebook Inc., Google Inc., and the ParentZone.』——Przybylski 曾无偿担任 Facebook 与 Google 的顾问,已在文中披露,无财务利益。资助方为 EU Horizon 2020 IBSEN(Orben)与 ESRC Understanding Society Fellowship(Przybylski),声明『funders had no role』。数据由 CDC/NIDA-Michigan/UCL CLS 提供。分析代码公开于 https://github.com/OrbenAmy/NHB_2019,预注册/材料见 https://osf.io/phf8v。

易混淆点提示:『眼镜 1.5x』的对比同时出现在本文(NHB 2019, MCS)与同年另一篇 Orben & Przybylski (Psychological Science 2019, 'Screens, Teens, and Psychological Well-Being: Evidence From Three Time-Use-Diary Studies') 的牛津新闻稿中。牛津 OII 新闻稿 (https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk/news-events/news/study-finds-screen-time-even-before-bed-has-little-impact-on-teen-well-being/) 的『wearing glasses had a more negative association』指的是 Psych Science 那篇时间日记研究,不是本文。引用 1.5x/MCS 时必须锚定 NHB 2019,别引成新闻稿。
unresolved: 正式发表版(Version of Record, Nat Hum Behav 3:173-182)全文被 Springer Nature 付费墙拦截(nature.com 重定向至 idp.nature.com 登录)。摘要已通过 PubMed 与 ORA 两个独立镜像逐字确认;但 Discussion 中 0.9x/1.5x/2.7x/4.3x/1.7x-44.2x 那一段、以及 Methods 中各库年份与人数,只核到 ORA 官方存档的作者接受稿 (AAM, Orben-and-Przybylski-Nature-Human-Behaviour-AAM.pdf)。旁证支持这些数字进入了发表版:牛津大学新闻稿(经 medicalxpress 2019-01-14 转载)逐字给出『2.7 times and 4.3 times more negative association』,发表版 2020 Reply 复述了眼镜对比。但『44.2x』这一具体数字未能在 AAM 之外的一手渠道二次确认。

AAM 与发表版摘要存在若干无实质差异的编辑性措辞变动(AAM: 'an analytic flexibility'、'Specification Curve Analysis'、'(ntot = 355,358)'、'correlational evidence for digital technology affecting adolescents';发表版: 'an analytical flexibility'、'specification curve analysis (SCA)'、'(total n = 355,358)'、'correlational evidence for the effects of digital technology on adolescents')。逐字引用时应以发表版为准。待验论断所引的两个片段在两版中均逐字一致,不受影响。
未能取得 Twenge et al. 2020 批评文的一手全文(Nature 付费墙,ResearchGate 为 Request PDF)。其六项批评的具体内容只能通过作者 Reply 的转述与二手来源重建,存在被 Reply 单方框定的风险。

corrections: 【(a) 0.4% 的统计量单位与「at most」的范围】修正前:引用「explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being」暗示 0.4% 是该效应变异解释率的上界。修正后:0.4% 是 partial η²(表2列名逐字为「Median partial η2 of SCA」),非总变异 R²;且「at most」指三数据集 Complete SCA 中位数的最大者(YRBS 0.001、MTF <0.001、MCS 0.004),不是全部所报告分析的上界。表2 中 MCS 子分析明显更高:Own a computer only partial η²=0.011(1.1%)、Hours of social media use only=0.009、Adolescent-report well-being only=0.008、Use of home Internet only=0.006。即子口径可达摘要「上界」的约 2.75 倍。作者 2020 Reply 逐字自证该口径:「median β = - 0.032, percent variance explained = 0.4%」——对应 MCS Complete SCA。引用摘要句无误,但不可当作「效应至多解释 0.4%」的全域上界。

【(a) 省略号吞掉了条件从句】修正前:「...too small to warrant policy change」直接接在 0.4% 之后。修正后:原文该结论带前置限定——完整句为「Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.」政策主张是「把数据的更广背景纳入考虑后」才成立的推论(即依赖 (c) 的对比基准),不是从 0.4% 直接得出。省略号处应保留该限定语。

【(b) n=355,358 是名义总样本,非分析样本】修正前:n=355,358 作为研究体量。修正后:该数字是 omnibus 总数,论文自身逐字警告「While the omnibus sample of adolescents totals 355,358 teenagers, it is important to note that the sample sizes of the analyses are often smaller, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more.」实际中位分析 n(表2 Complete SCA):YRBS 62,297、MTF 78,267、MCS 7,968。产出头条 0.4% 与眼镜对比的 MCS,中位 n 仅 7,968,约为 355,358 的 2.2%。

【(b) 2007-2016 是三库并集包络,非各库时间窗】修正前:三数据集=2007-2016。修正后:2007-2016 是论文对合并样本的表述(逐字:「surveyed between the years 2007 and 2016」),各库窗口不同:YRBS 逐字「collected from 2007 to 2015」;MTF 逐字「collected from 2008 to 2016」;MCS 非年份窗而是出生队列(「born between September 2000 and January 2001」),受访年龄 13-15 岁(mean 13.77, s.d. 0.45)。另:论文把 YRBS 拼作「Youth Risk and Behaviour Survey」,CDC 官方名为 Youth Risk Behavior Survey(无 and、美式拼写)。

【(c) 1.7x-44.2x 是「相反方向」的正向倍数】修正前:「睡眠早餐 1.7x-44.2x」未标方向。修正后:表3 星号注释逐字「* Denotes when the effect of the comparison variable on well-being is positive, and therefore in the opposite direction to the effect of technology use.」Sleep 与 Breakfast 在三库全部带星号。正文亦逐字作「ranging from ×1.7 to ×44.2 more positive in all datasets」。须写成「更正向 1.7-44.2 倍」,不能与大麻/霸凌的负向倍数并列陈述。

【(c) 该区间两端都来自「睡眠」,不是睡眠与早餐各占一端】修正前:「睡眠早餐 1.7x-44.2x」易读作睡眠与早餐分别为两端。修正后:表3 精确值 Sleep = YRBS ×3.06*、MTF ×44.23*、MCS ×1.65*;Breakfast = YRBS ×2.37*、MTF 30.55*、MCS ×3.32*。下界 1.65(Sleep@MCS)与上界 44.23(Sleep@MTF)均出自 Sleep 行;Breakfast 全域仅 2.37-30.55。

【(c) 倍数的分母是各库自身的技术效应,MTF 分母近零导致 44.2x 不可解读】修正前:44.2x 被当作睡眠重要性的实质证据。修正后:表3 注释逐字给出分母「For the YRBS the average effect linking technology to well-being was β = −0.049; for the MTF the average effect linking technology to well-being was β = −0.006; for the MCS the average effect linking technology to well-being was β = −0.042.」MTF 分母 −0.006 近乎为零,故 MTF 列全部倍数被机械放大且不稳定。铁证:论文自己归类为「Neutral Factors」的项在 MTF 同样爆表——Music ×32.68、Vegetables ×20.63(Positive)、Cigarettes ×18.47、Religion ×16.29、Going to movies ×11.51。若 44.2x 说明睡眠重要,则「听音乐 32.7x」「宗教 16.3x」「看电影 11.5x」同样成立,显系分母伪影。引用 44.2x 时必须同时给出 MTF 分母 β=−0.006。

【(c) 正文倍数是表3的四舍五入,且分母口径与表2不同】修正前:土豆 0.9x、眼镜 1.5x。修正后:表3 精确值为 Potatoes ×0.86(YRBS)、Glasses ×1.45(MCS);正文取整为「×0.9, YRBS」「×1.5, MCS」。另表3 注释逐字声明分母与表2不同源:「Please note that these figures may be different from those found in Table 2, because the mean of technology use measures was used in these analyses.」故 YRBS 倍数分母为 −0.049,而表2 YRBS Complete SCA 中位 β 为 −0.035,二者不可混用。
evidence_notes: 【一手全文获取】Nature 正式版对 WebFetch 返回 303 跳转至 idp.nature.com 登录墙,无法直读。改用两个独立来源交叉核对,二者摘要逐字一致:(1) 出版版 PDF 镜像 https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/2019-orben.pdf(含 DOI 头 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41562-018-0506-1、Nature Human Behaviour 版式、表2/表3/图1-5);(2) 牛津 ORA 作者接受稿 AAM https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5d844350-a359-47d3-b10c-4bfb93ce613b/download_file?file_format=application%2Fpdf&safe_filename=Orben-and-Przybylski-Nature-Human-Behaviour-AAM.pdf 。两份 PDF 均以 pdftotext -layout 本地抽取全文后逐行比对。

【(a) 摘要逐字 — 成立】出版版原文:「The association we find between digital technology use and adolescent well-being is negative but small, explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being. Taking the broader context of the data into account suggests that these effects are too small to warrant policy change.」ORA AAM 第 11-13 行文字完全相同。待验引语的两个片段「negative but small, explaining at most 0.4% of the variation in well-being」与「too small to warrant policy change」均逐字命中,无改写。

【(a) 0.4% 的来源定位】表2「Results of SCA for the YRBS, MTF and MCS」列 Median partial η2 of SCA:YRBS Complete SCA 0.001、MTF Complete SCA <0.001、MCS Complete SCA 0.004(median β −0.032, median n 7,968, s.e.m. 0.010)。0.004 即 0.4%,为三者最大值。作者 2020 Reply(Europe PMC 作者稿)逐字确认:「median β = - 0.032, percent variance explained = 0.4%」。

【(b) n 与数据集 — 成立】摘要逐字「applying specification curve analysis (SCA) across three large-scale social datasets (total n = 355,358)」。Methods 逐字「This paper's analysis pipeline spans three nationally representative datasets from the United Stats of America and the United Kingdom, encompassing a total of 355,358, predominately 12- to 18-year-old adolescents surveyed between the years 2007 and 2016.」正文逐字「Monitoring the Future (MTF), Youth Risk and Behaviour Survey (YRBS) and Millennium Cohort Study (MCS) from the United States of America (MTF, YRBS) and the United Kingdom (MCS)」。三库名称、总 n、2007-2016 窗口均命中。

【(b) 各库明细】YRBS:1990 年创立,biennial,美国 9-12 年级;逐字「The resulting sample from the YRBS was collected from 2007 to 2015 and included 37,402 girls and 37,412 boys, ranging in age from '12 years or younger' to '18 years or older' (median = 16, s.d. = 1.24).」MTF:1975 年创立,年度调查,8/10/12 年级(12 年级因关键题项无法相关而排除);逐字「The resulting sample from the MTF was collected from 2008 to 2016, and included 136,190 girls and 132,482 boys」。MCS:逐字「follows a specific cohort of children born between September 2000 and January 2001」,分析样本「5,926 girls and 5,946 boys who ranged in age from 13 to 15 years (mean 13.77, s.d. 0.45), and 10,605 primary caregivers」。三者相加 74,814+268,672+11,872 = 355,358,与总数吻合(照护者不计入)。

【(c) 对比倍数正文逐字 — 全部成立】Discussion 原文:「For example, in all three datasets the effects of both smoking marijuana and bullying have much larger negative associations with adolescent well-being (×2.7 and ×4.3, respectively for the YRBS) than does technology use. Positive antecedents of well-being are equally illustrative; simple actions such as getting enough sleep and regularly eating breakfast have much more positive associations with well-being than the average impact of technology use (ranging from ×1.7 to ×44.2 more positive in all datasets). Neutral factors provide perhaps the most useful context in which to judge technology engagement effects: the association of well-being with regularly eating potatoes was nearly as negative as the association with technology use (×0.9, YRBS), and wearing glasses was more negatively associated with well-being (×1.5, MCS).」→ 土豆 0.9x 确出自 YRBS、眼镜 1.5x 确出自 MCS、二者确非同一数据集(论文自身即显式标注库名)、大麻 2.7x 与霸凌 4.3x 确为 YRBS、睡眠早餐区间确为 1.7x-44.2x。待验论断 (c) 的五项归属全部命中。

【(c) 表3 完整精确值(Table 3 | Comparison specification results,列序 YRBS/MTF/MCS)】Negative Factors:Binge-drinking ×2.95/×8.10/×1.02;Marijuana ×2.70/×10.09/×1.14;Bullying ×4.33/–/×4.92;Getting into fights ×3.65/×15.58/–;Cigarettes –/×18.47/–;Being arrested –/–/×0.96。Neutral Factors:Perceived weight ×1.02/–/–;Potatoes ×0.86/–/–;Asthma ×1.34/–/–;Milk ×0.28*/–/–;Going to movies –/×11.51*/–;Religion –/×16.29*/–;Music –/×32.68/–;Homework –/×3.57*/–;Cycling –/–/×1.88*;Height –/–/×1.53*;Glasses –/–/×1.45;Handedness –/–/×0.10。Positive Factors:Fruit ×0.11/×9.49*/×1.32*;Vegetables ×0.27/×20.63*/×1.52*;Sleep ×3.06*/×44.23*/×1.65*;Breakfast ×2.37*/30.55*/×3.32*。

【(c) 眼镜对比的底层系数】图5 注释逐字:「Wearing glasses has the most negative association with adolescent well-being (black, median β = −0.061, median n = 7,963, partial η2 =0.005, median standard error =0.010); and more negative than the association of technology use with well-being (purple, median β = −0.042, median n = 7,964, partial η2 = 0.002, median standard error =0.010).」0.061/0.042 = 1.45,与表3 ×1.45 自洽。同图另列 handedness β=−0.004、height β=0.065、bicycle β=0.080。

【反证检索:后续争议 — 存在但未推翻原文】Twenge, Haidt, Joiner & Campbell (2020)「Underestimating digital media harm」Nat Hum Behav 4:346-348 (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-0839-4),Matters Arising,主张原文有六项分析选择压低了效应量,尤以女生社媒使用为甚,并主张「百分比变异解释」不是评估效应大小的有用指标。

【反证检索:作者答辩 — 一手可及】Orben & Przybylski「Reply to: Underestimating digital media harm」Nat Hum Behav 4:349-351,经 Europe PMC 作者稿 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7116236 与牛津 ORA 副本取得全文。关键逐字:「The results (Figure 1, Table 1) illustrate that the median association and effect size (β = - 0.051 [-0.072, -0.031], percent variance explained = 0.3% [0.2, 0.6]) are not significantly different from those in our original SCA (median β = - 0.032, percent variance explained = 0.4%). Wearing glasses was still more negatively associated with well-being in adolescents than digital technology use (βglasses = − 0.061 vs βtechnology = − 0.051).」注意 βtechnology=−0.051 出自按批评者建议重跑的 SCA,非原文的 −0.042,两者不构成矛盾。另逐字:「females showed a more negative association than males (females: median β = - 0.069 ..., males: median β = - 0.037 ...) and technology use predicted nearly one half of one percent of the variability in the well-being of girls.」即女生子群约 0.5%,略高于头条 0.4%。

【作者自身对倍数法的立场】Reply 中作者亦自承对比倍数法的脆弱性并以音乐为例逐字反证:「if we were to compare adolescents who listened to five hours or more of music a day (instead of focusing on technology), we would find that they have 16% lower well-being than those who listened to only ½ an hour or less – on this basis we might infer, incorrectly, that music has a negative impact on well-being.」这与表3 中 Music 在 MTF 达 ×32.68 相互印证:对比倍数用于框定量级,不宜作实质因果排序。

【勘误检索 — 未发现】未检得原文的 erratum / author correction / expression of concern / retraction。检索路径包括针对性 WebSearch 与 PubMed 记录查验(注:一次 PMID 试探命中无关的 Orthopade 勘误,已排除,非本文记录)。原文自 2019 年发表至今(核验日 2026-07-27)未见更正,学术争议仅以 Matters Arising + Reply 形式存在,原文正文与数字未被撤改。

A.K.P. has no competing financial interests; in the last five years A.K.P. has served in an unpaid advisory capacity with the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development, Facebook Inc., Google Inc. and the ParentZone.」即 Przybylski 曾以无薪顾问身份服务 Facebook 与 Google——考虑到本文结论对平台方有利,此项方向相关,但由作者主动披露且声明无财务利益。资助方逐字:MTF 由 National Institute on Drug Abuse 资助、YRBS 由 CDC 收集、MCS 由 UCL Centre for Longitudinal Studies 收集;A.O. 受 EU Horizon 2020 IBSEN 资助,A.K.P. 受 Understanding Society Policy Fellowship 资助。均非产业资金。

【论文自陈的局限(支持谨慎引用)】Discussion 逐字承认:使用简单线性回归而忽略关系可能「more complex, non-linear or hierarchical」;「Many measures used were also of low quality, non-normal, heterogenous or outdated」;自陈式技术使用测量「are known to be noisy」,可能反而低估效应;以及使用 NHST 在超大数据下本身有问题。另 MCS 因算力限制仅抽取 20,004 个 specification(全域 603,979,752 个),YRBS 372 个、MTF 40,966 个。
